title: Tea
content: Tea is a popular drink made from tea leaves. It originated in China and is widely produced in Sri Lanka (Ceylon tea).

title: Mountain
content: Mountains are large natural elevations formed by tectonic forces. The highest is Mount Everest.

title: River
content: Rivers are flowing water bodies that travel from mountains to seas.

title: Sun
content: The Sun is a star at the center of our solar system and provides energy for life.
